parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The reason why you add the vulnerability to the whitelist.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the whitelist. Valid values:

*   **image**
*   **agentless**

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description:
The vulnerability that you want to add to the whitelist. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and contains the following fields:

*   **type**: The type of the vulnerability. The value is fixed to repo.
*   **target**: The content of the vulnerability. The value is in the format of Namespace/Image repository.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas update-image-vul-whitelist-target --id 2000083 --target type_:_repo_,_target_:_sas_test/script_0209_,_sas_test/script --reason ignore --lang zh --source image --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas UpdateImageVulWhitelistTarget --region cn-hangzhou --Target 'type_:_repo_,_target_:_sas_test/script_0209_,_sas_test/script' --Lang zh --Id 2000083 --Reason ignore --Source image
